## Left open by the earlier read (RD-124)

An independent reader judged the previous rewrite of this lesson. Fix everything below as well. Each item is as serious as an item under "Fix these".

### Findings

1. Rule L02 (Major). Problem: This is a General Information lesson, but the teaching is in Filipino throughout. L02 requires simple English. The Filipino-language exception is for lessons teaching Filipino grammar, vocabulary or reading; this lesson teaches constitutional law.
   > Ang **pagkamamamayan** (citizenship) ay pagiging kasapi ng isang bansa ayon sa batas.
2. Rule L26 (Major). Problem: The brief requires teaching retention as well as reacquisition under RA 9225. This says only that retention has conditions. It does not explain that natural-born citizens who become foreign citizens after the Act retain Philippine citizenship upon the prescribed oath. The preceding paragraph explains reacquisition only.
   > May tuntunin din ang batas sa pagpapanatili ng pagkamamamayan sa ilalim ng mga kondisyon nito.
